note: Neither rungs nor a floor. A delivery with nothing in it extends nothing and forgets nothing; it is refused rather than answered.
An empty `links` array. Absent is how a request that only relays a floor is spelled; an empty array is a second spelling of the same thing.
A rung claiming epoch 1. The room's first epoch has no predecessor, so a rung numbered 1 wraps something that is not an earlier epoch's key.
